reviews.performance: Runs corpus evaluation repeatedly and reports per-run SQL percentiles plus wall time. It skips first run for warm summaries, but percentile-of-run-percentiles is not a pooled query percentile and weighting varies with missing results.
reviews.reliability: Reports workspaceStable rather than failing if false and does not reject failed retrieval criteria before producing timing. One iteration is labelled warm despite no warm-up; persisted corpus path normalization replaces double backslashes only. Preserve sample scope and reader identity when interpreting performance.

reviews.performance: Uses Workers independent PowerShell jobs and one Node process for each query, so measured latency includes process startup rather than the primary in-process route. Compare explicitly named routes and account for job startup in throughput.

reviews.performance: Loads policy, doctor and bounded handoff, recursively redacts values, fingerprints and publishes one export, then rereads it for self-verification. reviews.reliability: Source/JSON paths are policy-bound, output is temp-published and rescanned, and logs/arbitrary files are excluded. reviews.performance: Sealing invokes repeated workspace/status plus many conformance/requirements/proof/risk/context/model/critique validators and outcome writers before final result. reviews.reliability: Hash seal binds named artifacts and policy, and finish rechecks ready after refresh. Workspace lexical regex accepts nested dot-dot segments; verify resolved containment. Completion verification does not independently require the mandatory artifact set and permits legacy policy semantics. JSON/Markdown publication and subsequent optional observations are not one transaction: later learning-health/context/model/instruction failures can leave a completion marker despite command failure. reviews.performance: Uses exact changed-path SQLite selection and can reuse compiled context input, but still scans all Wiki pages/frontmatter, repeatedly matches paths against projects/modules/guides, and collects bounded focused-test lists. External interruption and process-start failures lack catch-all active-tree cleanup; payload/frame output is not buffered/bounded by this coordinator.

reviews.performance: Pure one-check lookup over refreshed evidence; no I/O or subprocess.

Read-only label applies to SQLite query but recovery explicitly builds derived projection. Validated projection-source freshness and publication receipt are separate from current production/source behavior.

Publication is not atomic and optional retention can fail after write on reader sharing, like earlier query-cache defect. Concurrent retention and corruption omission need tests.

reviews.performance: One outcome payload keyed by completion fingerprint; no global registry reread. Skips ephemeral smoke workspaces before persistent write.

reviews.performance: Bounds parallel generator slots and deadlines, retains stage barriers and receipts.
